clips.title: The story
paras: Darnassus rises among Teldrassil’s high boughs as the kaldorei capital and refuge. Its tranquil waters and groves make it the night elves’ spiritual heart and the Alliance’s primary bastion on northern Kalimdor. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind and Archdruid Fandral Staghelm guide their people through the trials of newfound mortality.

Darnassus took shape after the Third War, honoring the night elves’ survival after they lost the immortality granted by their sacred World Tree, Nordrassil. Unlike the stone cities of Ironforge and Stormwind, it is an open, tranquil settlement of wood-crafted lodges, glowing shrines, and arched bridges over crystalline lakes. Vigilant Sentinels, towering ancients of war, and druids who shape trees watch the paths and preserve nature’s quiet within the city.

Darnassus speaks of kaldorei unity, though its leadership is divided between different duties. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind handles civil and military matters from the radiant Temple of the Moon, with the Sisters of Elune around her. Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the Cenarion Circle’s affairs and championed planting Teldrassil to restore the elves’ lost immortality. Malfurion Stormrage is lost in a mysterious slumber deep within the Emerald Dream, and Staghelm’s aggressive vision for the future often clashes with the more patient priesthood.
